review_basis: Checked against the pinned Bosch PDF pages named by each evidence item. Acceptance changes review status only; it supplies no register or transition semantics.
limitations: The 0x76 address is a board-selection input; the datasheet also permits 0x77.
The accepted model is only the requested sleep-mode configuration slice, not a complete BME280 model.
Extractor confidence values are uncalibrated and were not used as an acceptance threshold.
